newsitem.title: USA: FGIC says muni insurance volume up 33 pct in Q1 97.
newsitem.headline: FGIC says muni insurance volume up 33 pct in Q1 97.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co., a unit of General Electric Co's GE Capital Services, said Wednesday it insured $4.87 billion of municipal bonds in the first quarter of 1997, a 33 percent increase over the same period last year.

FGIC said it was the "first time in recent memory" that the company ranked second instead of third in the quarterly market share rankings, ousting AMBAC Inc's AMBAC Indemnity Corp subsidiary from its usual number two slot.
MBIA Insurance Corp, a unit of MBIA Inc, has not yet released its quarterly figures but is expected to hold on to its No. 1 market share rank, according to market sources.

FGIC has instituted a more conservative insurance approach in recent quarters, foregoing sectors such as health care which it sees as too unpredictable. The strategy has prompted concern among analysts that the company's volume figures may decline.

But an FGIC spokesman, Tito Davilla, said that in the water and sewer sector, which FGIC has targeted, the company had a 73 percent market share. For general obligation bonds, Davilla said the figure was 38 percent.
